meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of maneuver.

sentences.en: He was excellent, taking us safely in to locks and doing all of the tricky maneuvers.

sentences.en: The collapse of the former Yugoslavia has been aided and abetted by the various western powers using incredibly cynical maneuvers.

sentences.en: Physiological maneuvers result in an even greater augmentation in vein size, however these are difficult to sustain during venous puncture.

sentences.en: And for tricky low altitude maneuvers, new avionics, and dual head-up displays make it easier and safer to operate.

sentences.en: Exhibition mode includes new maneuvers which you could not have gotten befor.

sentences.en: Get ready to take flight, as Superman Returns ' revolutionary new mechanics allow you to take full command of your aerial maneuvers.

sentences.en: Never being one to give up, Simon hit overdrive and after some brave passing maneuvers he ended up a well deserved 4th.

sentences.en: The strength of rational thinking is in the ability to examine and remove self-deception, rationalizations, and other defensive mental maneuvers.

sentences.en: During this interregnum we begin a very original and interesting series of maneuvers.
sentences.vi: Trong khoảng thời gian này, chúng tôi bắt đầu một loạt các thao tác rất độc đáo và thú vị.

sentences.en: History (or what is called by that name) replying to these questions says that this occurred because Kutuzov and Tormasov and Chichagov, and this man and that man, did not execute such and such maneuvers...
sentences.vi: Lịch sử (hoặc cái được gọi bằng cái tên đó) trả lời những câu hỏi này nói rằng điều này xảy ra bởi vì Kutuzov và Tormasov và Chichagov, và người đàn ông này và người đàn ông kia, đã không thực hiện các cuộc điều động như vậy và như vậy ...
